summary: @servicetitan/responsive preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from the oven-sh/bun GitHub releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a bundled 727KB file `math_init.js` at the package root. `math_init.js` is a `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle using obfuscator.io-style string-array rotation (numeric/string array + shuffler + char-decoder) and mangled identifiers; setup.mjs itself is likewise obfuscated with `_0x...` locals. The `files` manifest in package.json only declares `dist` and `src` and does not list `math_init.js`. The package is advertised as a React responsive-components library, whose stated purpose does not require a second language runtime or an opaque JS bundle to be executed at install time. The result is arbitrary code execution under a fetched Bun runtime on every host that runs `npm install`, bypassing Node-based scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
